title: Desperado
syncedLyrics:
[00:19.22] Desperado
[00:23.31] Why don't you come to your senses?
[00:28.19] You've been out ridin' fences for so long now
[00:36.11] Oh, you're a hard one
[00:39.33] But I know that you got your reasons
[00:44.47] These things that are pleasin' you
[00:48.65] Can hurt you somehow
[00:53.72] Don't you draw the queen of diamonds, boy
[00:58.72] She'll beat you if she's able
[01:02.28] You know the queen of hearts is always your best bet
[01:09.99] Now it seems to me some fine things
[01:14.00] Have been laid upon your table
[01:17.74] But you only want the ones that you can't get
[01:24.06] Desperado
[01:28.76] Oh, you ain't gettin' no younger
[01:33.99] Your pain and your hunger
[01:37.82] They're drivin' you home
[01:42.18] And freedom, oh, freedom
[01:45.58] Well, that's just some people talkin'
[01:49.66] Your prison is walkin' through this world all alone
[01:59.03] Don't your feet get cold in the wintertime?
[02:03.13] The sky won't snow and the sun won't shine
[02:07.24] It's hard to tell the nighttime from the day
[02:15.07] You're losing all your highs and lows
[02:18.85] Ain't it funny how the feeling goes away?
[02:29.20] Desperado
[02:33.49] Why don't you come to your senses?
[02:38.73] Come down from your fences
[02:43.17] Open the gate
[02:46.60] It may be rainin'
[02:49.87] But there's a rainbow above you
[02:54.58] You better let somebody love you
[02:58.81] (Let somebody love you)
[03:01.57] You better let somebody love you
[03:07.40] Before it's too late
[03:20.26]
